learning_outcomes.text: Students can reproduce the fundamental structure of computer systems. They possess basic knowledge of information encoding in computers. They know the fundamental structure and execution of programs, as well as the essential linguistic means of a procedural programming language. Students are able to create simple programs in a procedural programming language. This includes the ability to identify and correct errors in programs.

Students are able to diagnose the functioning of simple programs and describe them using appropriate technical vocabulary. Students can analyze simple problems from the application area of electrical engineering or mechatronics and translate them into corresponding programs.

syllabus_topics: Examples of Electrical Engineering and Mechatronics Problems
assessment_rules: Graded assessment: Written exam or e-exam, scope as per applicable study regulations. Ungraded assessment: Experimental work, consisting of approximately 10 experiments in total. Passing the ungraded experimental work is required to be eligible for ECTS credits.
